name: spinner
useFor: Use Spinner for work that takes a few seconds with no known end (starting a thread, running checks), inside a disabled key, a tag or beside a line of text. For work with a known end, use Progress.
constraints: A spinner for content that should show a Skeleton
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the FAQ's hexagon mark (.faq__hex) set turning
title: Spinner
description: A 16px hexagon outline with a third of its edge drawn, turning steadily; it takes the color of its text and breathes in place with reduced motion.
